claims.statement: Twenty-two authored basic statement cases complete66 Toolbox inspections under hash seeds0/1/42 at3738 immutable regular Git c02 inputs plus two explicit probe/case overlays. Each run returns59 contiguous original Unicode scalar statement intervals and37 selected events with zero private origins; complete actual stdout is identical across the three seeds and outer/internal stderr is empty. Eleven repeated-contract fixtures each produce two events. Nineteen independent reason-sensitive diagnosis controls reject. Four unchanged consumers pass52 complete groups with nine controls; the original incorrect AST-suite selection/source/exit/channels are retained separately and the corrected selection is fully rerun. Three original compiler-inspection examples render from58 separately retained final publication inputs with five controls. The previous consumer claim freezes historically at exact c02 after all37 bound input hashes verify, and two prepare-producer docstrings alone are clarified.
claims.scope: Bounded default-callback source/frame diagnosis, not production source provenance implementation, arbitrary host-language coverage, custom interior-transform callback coverage, executable membership/comment semantic repair, runtime execution, DSL/backend admission or global prior-record audit closure. The author oracle assembles literal original segments and scalar offsets; it never locates source by equal raw strings. Input count is a conservative supplied-input superset, not an observed minimal IO read set. Gitlinks/non-regular entries are excluded without payload reads; all regular Git bytes are recoverable at c02ce88826f815c201a652d5b29bd3cf044d2740, and the two exact overlays are retained. Every actual run has contents/modes/population checks before and after execution. Original exploratory six-case stdout retains its derived runtime callback locator losslessly and is not promoted to fixed-input acceptance. Read-only host OS/Perl/standard libraries and PATH-resolved prove/mdBook are necessary external execution prerequisites; consumer/render executable SHA identities are observed separately, no cross-host byte-identical transcript claim. Project-owned scratch/output stays on the repository filesystem. Private frames, eleven producer hooks and canonical statement-family acceptance are owned by .1/.2/.3; sibling twenty-contract composition and broader audit remain open.
